title: Systems
description: maipai.systems/1: the inside of a robot. Every piece belongs to one system, every system sits in one layer, every system lists its components, and each component has one type, one owner, a status per body, a memory budget, interfaces in and out, tests and docs. Part ids come from vocab/robot-api.json and capability ids from vocab/capabilities.json; this file copies neither. The cross-field rules (no reaching up a layer, one owner per piece of state, ids resolve, every component has an owner) cannot be written in JSON Schema and live in scripts/check-systems.ts. A new body adds its id to `bodies`; every `status` object then carries that key.

bodies.description: The bodies a status can be given for: `stackchan`, `reachy`, and `none` (no body: a screen or voice-only bot).

layers.description: Layer 0 is the base (stock seams, no systems of ours). A system's layer may call only systems in a lower layer.

state.description: How far a piece is built on one body, in the feature ledger's words.

status.description: One state per body id in `bodies`. The key set is checked against `bodies` by the rule check.

switch.description: The build switch that compiles the piece in.

load.description: When the piece takes its memory. `on_demand` and `setup_only` share the admit-then-stop life cycle.

id.description: `<system>.<name>`; the prefix is the owning system's id.

type.description: driver: touches hardware or a stock seam. service: owns state and offers calls. behavior: decides when to act, owns no hardware. asset: loaded or installed data. adapter: the host or brain half of a system, reaches the unit only through tools.

owns.description: State only this component may write.

uses.description: Calls made (`<system>::<name>`), or tool names for an adapter.

tests.description: Repo paths of the tests that prove it.

safety.description: privacy: mics, camera, memory, anything that leaves the robot. physical: moves, heat, battery. trust: keys, passwords, pairing, updates.

id.description: The C++ namespace and folder name. Never changes.

owner.description: The track that answers for it.

parts.description: Part ids from vocab/robot-api.json this system serves.

never.description: Rules this system never breaks, one line each.
